name: OneChange
$vocabularyNote: `target` is deliberately not a number and cannot be made into one. no_calorie_targets forbids calorie_goal, macro_goal and meal_logging_requirement, so this programme's target is a named behaviour a person chose — 'sit down to eat dinner' — and the thing that is counted is how many such changes are still being held (the area's sustained_change measure). The area catalogue defines no weight measure and no intake measure, and none is invented here.

helplines.name: 988 Línea de Prevención del Suicidio y Crisis

$helplineNote: disordered_eating_guard makes an eating-disorder support line the right thing to list here, and one is deliberately absent. No number was printed because none could be checked as currently correct at the time of writing — this machine has no network access, and the best-known US eating-disorder helpline changed hands and operating model in recent years. A wrong number in a bad hour is worse than no number, so S18 says out loud that a national line exists, says why no digits are shown, and routes to the care team and to 988 instead. Printing a guessed number here would be the single most dangerous thing in this file.

screens.$note: The disordered_eating_guard branch. A second instance of next_step, reached from the check-in and from S12, whose one recommended action is to withdraw measurement rather than add it: counts off, slider off, weekly figures off, programme still running. Its routing card sends the conversation to a clinician rather than to a non-clinical coach.

platformCapabilities.$note: Nothing is read from the phone. No step counter, no health store, no photo library, no barcode scanner, no food database. Activity minutes are what the person says they did. The area catalogue's two measures — activity_minutes and sustained_change — are the only two numbers the programme keeps, and there is no weight field and no intake field anywhere in the data model to fill in later.

$safeguardNotes.never_prescribe: S16 scopeNote and S19 disclaimer say the library explains and does not prescribe: no diet is picked, no medicine, no procedure, no daily amount.
$safeguardNotes.no_calorie_targets: No screen shows a calorie figure, a macro figure or a portion figure, and no screen asks what was eaten. S06 sets a named behaviour, not an amount. Where the words 'calorie' or 'weight' appear they appear inside a statement of absence — S01, S13 and S17.
$safeguardNotes.no_weight_streaks: The programme never collects weight, so it cannot streak it. S17 carries a card saying there is no weight line and why. Nothing anywhere compares Rosa to another person.
$safeguardNotes.disordered_eating_guard: S11 carries the screening prompt as two optional check-in chips. S13 is the response: measurement withdrawn, not tightened, plus clinician routing away from the non-clinical coach. S19 keeps the quieter mode reachable without going through a check-in.
$safeguardNotes.self_report_only: self_report_disclaimer appears on S04 and S11, the two screens that collect a rating.
$safeguardNotes.export_and_delete: S03 exit promise, S19 export and hard-delete cards, both routed to the shell record screen.
